note: Rolling median of individual completed eBay sales of sealed One Piece booster boxes, sampled every 7 days and dated by SALE date (not collection date). The averaging window is chosen per series (28-56 days) so that each point rests on roughly 12 sales, because sales volume differs more than tenfold between sets; each series records the window it used. Rebuilt from data/box-sold-ledger.json on every run, so a change in how listings are collected cannot show up as a price move. Windows with fewer than 6 sales are omitted rather than estimated. Only fixed-price (Buy It Now) sales are included; auction results are collected separately and excluded, because an auction that draws no bidding closes far below the going rate. Sales dated before an edition's official release date (pre-orders) are excluded from the sold series and summarized separately per set under preRelease (median only when at least 3 different listings sold). current is the latest point when the edition is released and that point is within 28 days of asOf, otherwise null. Prices are per box in USD. A monthly view (median of every sale within each calendar month, minimum 6 sales) is included alongside, because sets with wide dispersion between individual sales are steadier when grouped by month. Outlier sales (listed per set under outliers) are left out of medians: a sale is an outlier when it lies more than 3.5 x max(1.4826 x MAD, 20% of median) from the median of both the 90 days before and the 90 days after its sale date, each side holding at least 8 sales. out = sales left out of that point; win = that point's window in days when it was lengthened (up to 56 days, 120 for the first-print series) to keep 6 sales after leaving outliers out; when even that falls short, the point keeps all sales. vol and counts include outliers.
